the needle pointing right or straight up (it rests hard LEFT)
any glow, hum lines or output from the engine
descriptor._caption: Another founder barely starts her engine. She circles it. She reads about it. She waits for it to be safer, cheaper, more proven. The plain around her fills with lights, and her plot stays dark, and the era does not wait with her.
